claims.claim_text: Section 12 requires each applicant for registration as an architect to pass a licensure examination.
Section 14 lists four numbered examination subject groups.
Section 15 requires a weighted general average of 70 percent and no grade lower than 50 percent in any given subject.
Section 16 requires the Board to submit ratings to the Commission within thirty calendar days after the examination unless extended for just cause.
Section 13 authorizes action against false evidence, false information, false swearing, and misrepresentation in applications.
